create_jacobianreg_loss: create a JacobianReg loss criterion to compute the trace of the square of the Jacobian for robust learning
run_jacobianreg_forward: run the JacobianReg forward pass with input x and output y to compute (1/2) tr |dy/dx|^2
build_jacobianreg_exact: build a JacobianReg module with n=-1 for exact orthonormal projection instead of random approximation
review_jacobian_vector_product: review the _jacobian_vector_product method that computes dy/dx dot v using torch.autograd.grad
test_random_vector_generation: test the _random_vector method that creates a random vector of dimension C with norm C^(1/2)
